title: Zero-Cost Model Improvement — Market Baseline + Calibration + Feature Engineering
summary: A strict temporal market benchmark, zero-cost feature pipeline, logistic/residual/boosted models, three calibration methods and a calibrated ensemble were evaluated on the frozen five-league longitudinal dataset. The selected model was worse than the de-vigged market on both Brier and Log Loss; positive-EV research results were negative or statistically inconclusive. No production PR was created.
blockers: No tested model beats the de-vigged market on final OOS probability quality.
Positive-EV returns are negative or statistically inconclusive.
PRE_CLOSING quote timestamps are unavailable, so live feature eligibility is not established.
next_action: Keep production unchanged. Continue research only if a longer zero-cost walk-forward sample or new legally usable zero-cost signal becomes available; require robust market outperformance before any production proposal.
